# IdiotProof MCP tools

<!-- Generated by `dotnet run --project IdiotProof.Mcp -- --export-tools`. Do not hand-edit. -->

110 tools, one per Hub operation. Each forwards to the running Hub; `money` tools return a
confirmation code for Live actions instead of executing them. Times are US Eastern.

## `account_activities`

Account activity log: fills, dividends, fees, deposits, interest, option expirations/assignments (newest first, ET).

CLI equivalent: idiotproof account activities [--since <date>] [--until <date>] [--type <string[]>] [--limit <int>] [--mode <all|paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof account activities
  idiotproof account activities --since 2026-10-01 --type FILL --mode paper
  idiotproof account activities --type DIV,FEE,INT

Read-only. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Account activity log: fills, dividends, fees, deposits, interest, option expirations/assignments (newest first, ET).",
  "properties": {
    "since": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "First ET date to include, yyyy-MM-dd (default: 7 days ago)."
    },
    "until": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "Last ET date to include, yyyy-MM-dd (default: today)."
    },
    "type": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Activity types, comma-separated: FILL, DIV, FEE, CSD (deposit), CSW (withdrawal), JNLC, INT, OPEXP, OPASN, ... (default: all)."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Most rows per account, newest first (default 100, max 1000).",
      "default": 100
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "all",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "paper, live or all (default all).",
      "default": "all"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## `account_calendar`

Trading days with premarket, regular and after-hours times (ET); early closes and holidays called out.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof account calendar [--from <date>] [--to <date>] [--mode <sandbox|paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof account calendar
  idiotproof account calendar --from 2026-11-20 --to 2026-12-31

Read-only. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Trading days with premarket, regular and after-hours times (ET); early closes and holidays called out.",
  "properties": {
    "from": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "First date, yyyy-MM-dd (default today ET)."
    },
    "to": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "Last date, yyyy-MM-dd (default 14 days after --from)."
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sandbox",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "Which Alpaca account\u0027s keys ask: paper or live (default paper; the calendar is the same).",
      "default": "paper"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## `account_config_set`

Change one Alpaca account setting (Live needs a confirmation code).

CLI equivalent: idiotproof account config set <setting> <value> [--mode <sandbox|paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof account config set no_shorting true
  idiotproof account config set max_margin_multiplier 1 --mode live

Changes saved state. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Change one Alpaca account setting (Live needs a confirmation code).",
  "properties": {
    "setting": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "dtbp_check, pdt_check, trade_confirm_email, suspend_trade, no_shorting, fractional_trading, max_margin_multiplier, max_options_trading_level or ptp_no_exception_entry.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "value": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "The new value (see \u0060account config\u0060 for each setting\u0027s meaning).",
      "default": ""
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sandbox",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "paper or live (default paper; live needs a confirmation code).",
      "default": "paper"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "setting",
    "value"
  ]
}
```

## `account_history`

Equity over time as a Braille line chart, with the true P&L (deposits excluded) for 1D to all-time windows.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof account history [--period <string>] [--timeframe <string>] [--extended] [--mode <sandbox|paper|live>] [--width <int>] [--height <int>]
Examples:
  idiotproof account history
  idiotproof account history --period 1D --timeframe 5Min --extended
  idiotproof account history --period 1A --mode live

Read-only. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Equity over time as a Braille line chart, with the true P\u0026L (deposits excluded) for 1D to all-time windows.",
  "properties": {
    "period": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Window: \u003Cn\u003ED, \u003Cn\u003EW, \u003Cn\u003EM or \u003Cn\u003EA (years), or all (default 1M).",
      "default": "1M"
    },
    "timeframe": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Point spacing: 1Min, 5Min, 15Min, 1H or 1D (default: Alpaca\u0027s choice for the period)."
    },
    "extended": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Include premarket and after-hours in intraday history (default regular hours only).",
      "default": false
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sandbox",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "paper or live (default paper).",
      "default": "paper"
    },
    "width": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Chart width in characters (default: the terminal\u0027s, else 118)."
    },
    "height": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Chart rows (default 16).",
      "default": 16
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## `assets_bonds`

Alpaca fixed income assets: US Treasuries or US corporate bonds with coupon, maturity, last close and yield.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof assets bonds [--type <treasuries|corporates>] [--subtype <string>] [--bond-status <string>] [--cusips <string[]>] [--isins <string[]>] [--search <string>] [--limit <int>] [--mode <paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof assets bonds --subtype bill --limit 20
  idiotproof assets bonds --type corporates --search AAPL

Read-only. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Alpaca fixed income assets: US Treasuries or US corporate bonds with coupon, maturity, last close and yield.",
  "properties": {
    "type": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "treasuries",
        "corporates"
      ],
      "description": "treasuries (default) or corporates.",
      "default": "treasuries"
    },
    "subtype": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Treasury subtype filter (bill, note, bond, strips, tips, floating_rate)."
    },
    "bond_status": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Bond status filter (outstanding, matured, pre_issuance)."
    },
    "cusips": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Only these CUSIPs, comma separated."
    },
    "isins": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Only these ISINs, comma separated."
    },
    "search": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Keep bonds whose description, issuer, ticker, CUSIP or ISIN contains this text."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Rows to show (default 50; sorted by maturity).",
      "default": 50
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "Alpaca account to ask: paper (default) or live.",
      "default": "paper"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## `assets_list`

Alpaca's tradable universe (/v2/assets) filtered by class, exchange, status and attributes, with totals.

Alpaca returns 10k+ assets; this shows the first --limit matches (sorted by symbol) and how many matched in all.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof assets list [--class <us-equity|us-option|crypto>] [--exchange <string>] [--status <active|inactive|all>] [--attributes <string[]>] [--search <string>] [--tradable] [--shortable] [--limit <int>] [--mode <paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof assets list --class us_equity --exchange NASDAQ --search APP
  idiotproof assets list --class crypto --limit 100
  idiotproof assets list --attributes has_options --shortable

Read-only. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Alpaca\u0027s tradable universe (/v2/assets) filtered by class, exchange, status and attributes, with totals.",
  "properties": {
    "class": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "us-equity",
        "us-option",
        "crypto"
      ],
      "description": "us_equity, us_option or crypto (default: every class)."
    },
    "exchange": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only this exchange (NASDAQ, NYSE, ARCA, AMEX, BATS, OTC, CRYPTO...)."
    },
    "status": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "active",
        "inactive",
        "all"
      ],
      "description": "active, inactive or all (default active).",
      "default": "active"
    },
    "attributes": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Alpaca attribute filter, comma separated (ptp_no_exception, ptp_with_exception, ipo, has_options, options_late_close, fractional_eh_enabled...)."
    },
    "search": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Keep assets whose symbol starts with, or name contains, this text."
    },
    "tradable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Only assets tradable at Alpaca.",
      "default": false
    },
    "shortable": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Only shortable assets.",
      "default": false
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Rows to show (default 50; the totals line counts them all).",
      "default": 50
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "Alpaca account to ask: paper (default) or live.",
      "default": "paper"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

## `corporate_actions_list`

Splits, dividends, mergers, spinoffs and name changes from Alpaca (Market Data or Trading API announcements) over a date window.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof corporate-actions list [--types <string[]>] [--symbol <string[]>] [--since <date>] [--until <date>] [--source <data|announcements>] [--limit <int>] [--mode <paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof corporate-actions list --symbol AAPL,MSFT --types cash_dividend
  idiotproof corporate-actions list --types forward_split,reverse_split --since 2026-10-01 --until 2026-11-30
  idiotproof corporate-actions list --source announcements --types split --symbol NVDA

Read-only. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Splits, dividends, mergers, spinoffs and name changes from Alpaca (Market Data or Trading API announcements) over a date window.",
  "properties": {
    "types": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Types, comma separated. data: forward_split, reverse_split, unit_split, cash_dividend, stock_dividend, spin_off, cash_merger, stock_merger, stock_and_cash_merger, redemption, name_change, worthless_removal, rights_distribution. announcements: dividend, merger, spinoff, split."
    },
    "symbol": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "Only these symbols, comma separated."
    },
    "since": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "First date (default 30 days ago, ET)."
    },
    "until": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "Last date (default 30 days ahead, ET)."
    },
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "data",
        "announcements"
      ],
      "description": "data (Market Data, default) or announcements (Trading API, max 90-day window).",
      "default": "data"
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",

## `crypto_buy`

Buy a crypto pair (fractional, GTC/IOC) through the TransactionGateway. Paper by default; live needs a confirmation code.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof crypto buy <pair> [<qty>] [--notional <decimal>] [--limit <decimal>] [--trigger <decimal>] [--stop <decimal>] [--target <decimal>] [--tif <string>] [--mode <sandbox|paper|live>] [--note <string>]
Examples:
  idiotproof crypto buy BTC/USD 0.001 --limit 70000 --stop 66500
  idiotproof crypto buy ETH/USD --notional 250 --stop 2300 --mode live

MOVES MONEY. Sandbox and Paper run immediately. A Live action returns status confirmation-required with a preview and a code instead of executing: show the user the preview verbatim, ask them, and only if they say yes call this tool again with the identical arguments plus confirmation_code. Never invent or reuse a code. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Buy a crypto pair (fractional, GTC/IOC) through the TransactionGateway. Paper by default; live needs a confirmation code.",
  "properties": {
    "pair": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Crypto pair, e.g. BTC/USD.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "qty": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Coin quantity, fractional allowed (0.0015). Leave out and pass --notional to size by dollars."
    },
    "notional": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Size by dollar amount instead of coin quantity."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Limit price. Without it the order is a market order."
    },
    "trigger": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Stop trigger price: with --limit it makes a stop-limit order."
    },
    "stop": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Protective stop price for a buy; the Risk Guardian refuses entries without one."
    },
    "target": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Take-profit price (for the reward:risk check)."
    },
    "tif": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Time in force: gtc (default) or ioc.",
      "default": "gtc"
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sandbox",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "paper (default) or live (needs a confirmation code). Sandbox does not simulate crypto.",
      "default": "paper"
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Why: kept in the audit trail."
    },
    "confirmation_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only after the user explicitly approves the preview: the code a previous call of this tool returned."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "pair"
  ]
}
```

## `options_buy`

Buy option contracts to open (level 2+). Sandbox by default; live needs a confirmation code.

CLI equivalent: idiotproof options buy <occ> <contracts> [--limit <decimal>] [--mode <sandbox|paper|live>] [--note <string>]
Examples:
  idiotproof options buy AAPL261219C00150000 2 --limit 3.20 --mode paper
  idiotproof options buy SPY261120P00560000 1 --mode live

MOVES MONEY. Sandbox and Paper run immediately. A Live action returns status confirmation-required with a preview and a code instead of executing: show the user the preview verbatim, ask them, and only if they say yes call this tool again with the identical arguments plus confirmation_code. Never invent or reuse a code. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Buy option contracts to open (level 2\u002B). Sandbox by default; live needs a confirmation code.",
  "properties": {
    "occ": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "OCC contract symbol, e.g. AAPL261219C00150000.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "contracts": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Whole contracts (each is usually 100 shares).",
      "default": 0
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Limit price per share (premium). Without it the order is a market order."
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sandbox",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "Where it routes: sandbox (simulator, the default), paper, or live (needs confirmation).",
      "default": "sandbox"
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Why \u2014 kept in the audit trail."
    },
    "confirmation_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only after the user explicitly approves the preview: the code a previous call of this tool returned."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "occ",
    "contracts"
  ]
}
```

  idiotproof orders bracket AAPL buy 5 --take-profit 240 --stop-loss 220 --stop-loss-limit 219.5

    },

Never invent or reuse a code. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Sell shares you hold (close or trim a long). Exits always clear the gates.",
  "properties": {
    "symbol": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Ticker, e.g. NVDA.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "qty": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Shares. Leave out and pass --dollars to size by amount."
    },
    "dollars": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Size by dollar amount instead of shares (fractional, regular hours only)."
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Limit price. Without it the order is a market order."
    },
    "stop": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Protective stop price for an entry; the Risk Guardian refuses entries without one."
    },
    "target": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "Take-profit price (for the reward:risk check)."
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "sandbox",
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "Where it routes: sandbox (simulator, the default), paper, or live (needs confirmation).",
      "default": "sandbox"
    },
    "ext": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "description": "Extended hours (premarket/after-hours); requires --limit, DAY.",
      "default": false
    },
    "tif": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Time in force: day (default) or gtc.",
      "default": "day"
    },
    "note": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Why \u2014 kept in the audit trail."
    },
    "confirmation_code": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Only after the user explicitly approves the preview: the code a previous call of this tool returned."
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "symbol"
  ]
}
```

## `watchlists_add`

Add symbols to an Alpaca watchlist (by id or name).

CLI equivalent: idiotproof watchlists add <watchlist> <symbols>... [--mode <paper|live>]
Examples:
  idiotproof watchlists add tech AMD AVGO

Changes saved state. Times are US Eastern.

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "description": "Add symbols to an Alpaca watchlist (by id or name).",
  "properties": {
    "watchlist": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Watchlist id or name.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "symbols": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "description": "One or more symbols (space or comma separated)."
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "paper",
        "live"
      ],
      "description": "Alpaca account: paper (default) or live.",
      "default": "paper"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "watchlist",
    "symbols"
  ]
}
```
